doc.title: Slide Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003

title: The nickname Slide
summary: He started trombone at 12 and received the name Slide with it; his real name is Locksley Wellington.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: So they said we need a trombone player. You’re going to play trombone. And your name will be Slide whether you like it or not.
Does that go back that far?
Yes. From the time I started. I started actually playing trombone at 12. And when they gave me the trombone they gave me the name.
Because, is your name Locksley Wellington?
Yeah I got that out of the Grove Dictionary.
Yeah. Not many people know that.
Yeah. Okay. That’s really interesting, that they pinned that on you right away. Well nicknames help too.
